task.instruction: Find a recipe for Baked Salmon that takes less than 30 minutes to prepare and has at least a 4 star rating based on user reviews.

final_answer:
I found a recipe that meets both criteria: **Baked Salmon Fillets Dijon** on Allrecipes (https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/22538/baked-salmon-fillets-dijon/).

It's rated **4.6 out of 5** from **1,590 user ratings** (1,135 written reviews), and it's fast: **10 minutes prep, 15 minutes cook, 25 minutes total** — comfortably under your 30-minute limit. It's an Allrecipes Test Kitchen–tested recipe from contributor CHRISTYJ, serving 4.

How it's made: preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a shallow pan with foil. Place 4 salmon fillets skin-side down, spread a thin layer of Dijon mustard over each, season with salt and pepper, top with Italian-style bread crumbs, and drizzle with melted butter. Bake about 15 minutes, until the salmon flakes easily with a fork. Per serving: 331 calories, 25g protein, 22g fat, 8g carbs.

If you'd like a different option, other strong candidates from the same search were **Baked Dijon Salmon** (3,745 ratings) and **Best Baked Salmon** (4.8 stars, 3,242 ratings) — though that last one has a 1 hr 50 min total time, so it wouldn't fit your time limit.

judge.rationale: Final page and answer show Baked Salmon Fillets Dijon with 4.6 rating from 1,590 ratings and prep time 10 mins/total time 25 mins, satisfying the criteria.
